items.fact: Marks plus the rest of your profile
items.detail: Projects, internships and your SOP tell your story too. Read each course's requirements.

items.myth: Your internship must be at a big company
items.detail: If you did real work at a small company, explain it clearly in your SOP.

items.fact: Show work linked to your course
items.detail: Two or three relevant things you really did beat a long list.
